lines.phonemes: ɐ vˈɪzᵻbəl spˈɪl stˈeɪz ɐ pˈɜːsənz dʒˈɑːb, æz ðə lˈæbz vˈækjuːm pɹəsˈiːdʒɚ sˈɛz: ðə ɹˈoʊbɑːt stˈɑːps ænd mˈɛsɪdʒᵻz ðˌɛm. ðə pˈɜːsən swˈiːps ˌʌp ðə bˈʌlk wɪð ɐ nˈætʃɚɹəlbɹˈɪsəl bɹˈuːm ænd lˈiːvz ðə ɹˈɛsɪdˌuː tə ðə ɹˈoʊbɑːt.

lines.text: The whole night's pass, seen from above: fifty-three work spots and forty-five ground studs. Bonding and checking at every spot doubles the model's forty-three minutes to about an hour and a half.
lines.spoken: The whole night's pass, seen from above: fifty-three work spots and forty-five ground studs. Bonding and checking at every spot doubles the model's forty-three minutes to about an hour and a half.
lines.phonemes: ðə hˈoʊl nˈaɪts pˈæs, sˈiːn fɹʌm əbˈʌv: fˈɪftiθɹˈiː wˈɜːk spˈɑːts ænd fˈɔːɹɾifˈaɪv ɡɹˈaʊnd stˈʌdz. bˈɑːndɪŋ ænd tʃˈɛkɪŋ æɾ ˈɛvɹi spˈɑːt dˈʌbəlz ðə mˈɑːdəlz fˈɔːɹɾiθɹˈiː mˈɪnɪts tʊ ɐbˌaʊt ɐn ˈaʊɚ ænd ɐ hˈæf.

base.en.heard: The whole night's pass, seen from above, 53 work spots and 45 ground studs. Bonding and checking at every spot doubles the model's 43 minutes to about an hour and a half.

small.en.heard: The whole nights pass, seen from above. 53 work spots and 45 ground studs. Bonding and checking at every spot doubles the model's 43 minutes to about an hour and a half.

lines.text: Its two spills are illustrations, since the model has no spill rate. Whatever the robot leaves goes on the person's list for the morning.

lines.text: The largest hazardous stream would be powder the route never uses: about three quarters of every run comes out too coarse for the printer. What happens to it is undecided, and the amounts are modelled, not weighed.
lines.spoken: The largest hazardous stream would be powder the route never uses: about three quarters of every run comes out too coarse for the printer. What happens to it is undecided, and the amounts are modelled, not weighed.
lines.phonemes: ðə lˈɑːɹdʒɪst hˈæzɚdəs stɹˈiːm wʊd biː pˈaʊdɚ ðə ɹˈaʊt nˈɛvɚ jˈuːzᵻz: ɐbˌaʊt θɹˈiː kwˈɔːɹɾɚz ʌv ˈɛvɹi ɹˈʌn kˈʌmz ˈaʊt tˈuː kˈɔːɹs fɚðə pɹˈɪntɚ. wˌʌt hˈæpənz tʊ ɪɾ ɪz ˌʌndᵻsˈaɪdᵻd, ænd ðɪ ɐmˈaʊnts ɑːɹ mˈɑːdəld, nˌɑːt wˈeɪd.

base.en.heard: The largest hazardous stream would be powder the route never uses. About three-quarters of every run comes out two-course for the printer. What happens to it is undecided, and the amounts are modeled, not weighed.

lines.text: Everything hazardous leaves through BYU Risk Management's pickups: about one a month at one alloy a day, one every week or two at ten.
